[Branded Content] How much of Pune can you explore on a single charge?
We took the Suzuki e-Access across our home city for a full day, making stops at some of our favourite food spots while putting its claimed 95km range to a real-world test.
The day starts with a classic Pune breakfast of bun maska, cheese omelette and chai at Vohman’s Cafe, before we head through the city and stop at Le Plaisir for pasta and its iconic espresso panna cotta. After that, there’s a chai stop at Engineer’s Cafe, before we wrap up the day with a proper Maharashtrian meal at 7/12 (Saat Baara).
